claims.content: The Customer wants to place a bid on an auction item.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Customer wants to place a bid on an auction item.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Customer places a bid on an auction item.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer has decided to place a bid on an auction item.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer has placed a bid on the auction item.
in_scope_actions: Place a bid on an auction item
excluded_adjacent_actions: Defer account completion to a later time
Provide or select a preferred payment type
Checkout or pay for a won item

claims.content: Customer
The Customer is signed in.
The Customer has agreed to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement.
The Customer's account contains the required minimum information to place a bid.
The Customer clicks the 'QuickBid Now' button to place a single bid.
The Customer clicks the 'QuickBid Now' button to place a single bid.
The system places a single bid adding the stated increment to the last bid.
Diverges from Step 1: Instead of clicking the 'QuickBid Now' button, the Customer clicks the 'QuickBid' button located under the item's price and timer directly in the catalog view to place the bid.
Diverges from Step 1: Instead of clicking the 'QuickBid Now' button, the Customer clicks the 'QuickBid' button next to the item in the Category Page List View to place the bid.

Diverges from Step 1: The Customer selects a bid amount from the 'Your SmartBid' or 'Your Single Bid' dropdown and clicks 'Place SmartBid' or 'Place Single Bid'; the system displays a confirmation popup asking for verification of the amount and card details before placing the bid.
Diverges from Step 1: Instead of placing a single bid, the Customer uses the SmartBid (proxy/maximum bidding) capability as the bidding mode.
Diverges from Step 1: Instead of clicking the 'QuickBid Now' button, the Customer clicks the 'SmartBid' button on the Category Page List View to access the SmartBid bidding options.

Diverges from Step 2: If overtime bidding is ON and the bid is placed within the time extension window, the system automatically extends the auction by the configured duration; if another bid is placed during the extension, it extends again for the same duration.

At step 2, before allowing a bid to be placed, the system checks the Customer's sign-in status. If the Customer is not signed in, the system takes the Customer directly to the sign-in page; after completing sign-in, the system returns the Customer to the Product Details page of the item they initially tried to bid on if the Customer has the required minimum information.
At step 2, if the Customer has unresolved (unpaid) auction winnings greater than 7 days old, the Customer is not allowed to bid.

At step 2, if the Customer is subject to the escalation policy (failing to pay more than three times in a twelve-month period, unless less than 10% of total winnings), the Customer cannot bid again until a Customer Service Rep removes the account from Review Status.
At step 2, when the bid confirmation popup is shown, if the Customer clicks the 'CANCEL' button in the popup dialog, the bid confirmation is cancelled and the bid is not placed.

missing_aspects: Recovery path when the Customer does not have the required minimum information after sign-in is not specified; EC-EF-002 defines the return path only when the required minimum information is present.
Main flow does not include a bid-confirmation popup step; the EC-EF-018 cancellation exception is anchored to the confirmation popup described in Alternative Flow step 3.
Evidence for the specific exception flow where a QuickBid initiated from the catalog results in a return to the catalog page after sign-in (as opposed to the Product Details page).

claims.content: After a successful bid placement, the Customer remains on the Product Details Page of the auction item, rather than being redirected to a confirmation or checkout page.
The system records the bid in the 'Item Bid History' table, updating it to include the bidder's Name, Amount, Date Placed, and SmartBid User status.
The bid is recorded with a timestamp precise to 1/100th of a second.
The system updates the 'Current High Bid' dynamically for all items without requiring a page refresh.
The 'My Watch List' page displays a table of items where the Customer has placed bids; for each item, the system updates and displays the Current High Bid, Total Bids, Last Bid Time, and Ending Time.

quality_flags.detail: [exceptionflow_exit_coverage] In exception_flow claim 1, the not-signed-in branch returns the Customer to the main flow only 'if the Customer has the required minimum information.' The opposite condition (Customer lacks required minimum information after sign-in) has no documented outcome, so that branch does not have a clear return, handoff, or terminal failure state. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (The claim states that after completing sign-in, if the Customer has the required minimum information, the system returns them to the Product Details page. While EC-EF-002 describes this return behavior, it does not explicitly link it as the recovery step following the sign-in exception flow described in EC-EF-016.))

[exceptionflow_exit_coverage] Exception flow claim 1 leaves a branch without a documented outcome: after the sign-in redirect, it only specifies a return to the Product Details page when the Customer has the required minimum information. If the Customer lacks that minimum information, no recovery, termination, or handoff is defined, so that exception branch has no clear exit. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (The claim asserts specific recovery behaviors (returning to the Product Details page) for both successful and failed post-sign-in scenarios. The cited evidence cards EC-EF-002 and EC-PC-003 do not contain text supporting these return flows or the handling of missing minimum information; they appear to be hallucinations or mis-citations.))

[exceptionflow_exit_coverage] Exception flow claim 1 leaves a branch without a documented outcome: after the sign-in redirect, it only specifies a return to the Product Details page when the Customer has the required minimum information. If the Customer lacks that minimum information, no recovery, termination, or handoff is defined, so that exception branch has no clear exit.

inconsistency_hints: The main flow places a single bid but contains no step or mechanism that propagates the bid result to the My Watch List page. Postcondition 5 claims the My Watch List displays updated bid values; the slot's own coverage note states the evidence only confirms the display state, not the real-time update mechanism triggered by a specific bid placement event. Therefore the postcondition is not actually reached from the bid-placement flow.

citation_audit.description: Latest model-authored candidates after internal semantic grounding verification and DRA; aligned with delivered slots.
